_status: VERIFIED fields come from CS.xlsx; the section/label rules are RECONSTRUCTED from 20+ real Incepta URS files.
canonical_requirement_labels: Ink Jet/ USB/ SD Card supported print out option
Complies 21 CFR part 11 or Data integrity
row_rules: One URS point -> one row per bullet/(a)(b)/line/'Label: value' pair.
Column A = '<URS requirement> – <label>' (label dropped if it repeats the requirement). Column B = the value exactly as written.
Lines ending with ':' are group headings (kept as prefix only if <=4 words); intro lines ending in 'the/of/with' are dropped.
A bullet heading followed by plain value lines becomes prefix + value rows (e.g. 'External Dimensions (W x D x H)' + '1645 mm x 1057 mm x 2200 mm').
Never invent values. Unreadable OCR -> keep text and flag review (cell note), do not guess.
Software-URS tables (ID | Description | Priority): A = ID, B = description + '[Priority n]' (RECONSTRUCTED decision, confirm with the user).
